approval.note: A storyboard is a script, not footage. Every claim is qualitative rather than invented — a demo that fabricates a metric teaches the viewer something false, so this script says an agent accelerates a task and never says by how much. A human approves the script before anything is rendered.

scenes.narration: But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand. Now, with unified data context across CRM and Engagement history, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary. It can optimize resource allocation across deals in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on. With Action Prioritization, sales teams get guided assistance embedded directly into their workflows.
The result? Work that moves faster, stays consistent, and holds the same standard every time it runs. Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
